T1.implementation_approach: Design a user-friendly interface with search, filter, and categorization options for problems.
T1.notes: Ensure responsive design for various devices.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage problem data, including CRUD operations.
T2.notes: Use a scalable framework and ensure proper authentication.

T3.implementation_approach: Set up a relational database schema to store problem details, tags, and metadata.
T3.notes: Optimize for query performance and data integrity.

T4.implementation_approach: Connect frontend UI with backend APIs using REST or GraphQL.
T4.notes: Ensure seamless data flow and error handling.

T5.implementation_approach: Develop a feature to allow users to submit code and track submission status.
T5.notes: Include input validation and security checks.

T6.implementation_approach: Build a system to evaluate code submissions against test cases and provide feedback.

T7.implementation_approach: Design a clean and intuitive UI for code submission with syntax highlighting.

T8.implementation_approach: Integrate the code submission UI with backend APIs for submission and evaluation.
T8.notes: Handle edge cases like timeouts and large inputs.

T9.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage user profiles, including progress tracking and settings.
T9.notes: Ensure secure storage of user data.

T10.implementation_approach: Design a profile UI to display user details, progress, and achievements.

T11.implementation_approach: Connect the user profile UI with backend APIs for dynamic data updates.
T11.notes: Ensure real-time synchronization of user data.

T12.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to calculate and store leaderboard rankings based on user performance.
T12.notes: Optimize for frequent updates and large datasets.

T13.implementation_approach: Design a visually appealing leaderboard UI with sorting and filtering options.
T13.notes: Highlight top performers and user-specific rankings.

T14.implementation_approach: Integrate leaderboard UI with backend APIs for real-time ranking updates.
T14.notes: Ensure smooth data rendering and error handling.

T15.implementation_approach: Develop backend APIs to manage hints and solutions for problems.
T15.notes: Include access control based on user progress.

T16.implementation_approach: Design a UI to display hints and solutions in an organized and accessible manner.
T16.notes: Ensure clarity and avoid overwhelming users.

T17.implementation_approach: Integrate hints and solutions UI with backend APIs for dynamic content delivery.

T18.implementation_approach: Perform functional and usability testing for the problem library feature.
T18.notes: Test across different devices and browsers.

T19.implementation_approach: Test code submission and evaluation for accuracy, performance, and edge cases.
T19.notes: Simulate high-load scenarios for stress testing.

T20.implementation_approach: Test user profile features for data accuracy and synchronization.
T20.notes: Ensure secure handling of sensitive user data.

T21.implementation_approach: Test leaderboard functionality for ranking accuracy and real-time updates.
T21.notes: Verify scalability for large user bases.

T22.implementation_approach: Test hints and solutions feature for proper access control and content delivery.
T22.notes: Ensure clarity and relevance of provided hints.

T23.implementation_approach: Deploy the platform on a scalable cloud infrastructure with monitoring and backup systems.
T23.notes: Ensure proper security measures and post-deployment testing.
